description_en: Send a piece of broadcast text to the server. The digital human performs TTS generation, facial expression and action driving based on the text, and renders a video stream for the user. (We recommend using the upgraded APIs: SendText, SendVaml, or SendCommand.)
description_zh: 发送一段播报文本给到服务端，数字人会基于文本做TTS生成、表情动作驱动，并渲染视频流给到用户。（建议使用升级接口：SendText、SendVaml、SendCommand）
kebab_example: aliyun avatar send-message --session-id 76898bd3b90b4a65b1c078d8824a2e9c --tenant-id 5615 --text-request SpeechText=纯文本：这是一段示例播报纯文本_SSML：SSML使用请参考官方文档 CommandType=枚举值如下：_START_表示开始播报一段文本_HOLDING_表示暂停当前播报_RESUME_表示恢复当前播报 interrupt=false Id=0000001000586737 --vaml-request Vaml=参考文档 Code=VAML_REQUEST --feedback false --stream-extension Position=start IsStream=true Index=0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendMessage

parameters.help_en: Session ID. Obtain this value from the return value of the "Start a Digital Human" API
parameters.help_zh: 会话 SessionID。通过“启动一个数字人”API的返回值获取
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: Tenant ID obtained from the Digitized Virtual Human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

fields.example:
枚举值如下：
START 表示开始播报一段文本
HOLDING 表示暂停当前播报
RESUME 表示恢复当前播报
fields.help_en:
Command type:
START indicates starting to speak a segment of text.
HOLDING indicates pausing the current speech.
RESUME indicates resuming the current speech
fields.help_zh:
命令类型
START 表示开始播报一段文本
HOLDING 表示暂停当前播报
RESUME 表示恢复当前播报
fields.name: command_type

fields.help_en: ID corresponding to the SpeechText content. Supports up to 64-bit values and must be unique. A UUID can be used
fields.help_zh: 对应SpeechText文本的Id，最大支持64位，需要保持唯一，可使用UUID
fields.name: id

fields.example:
纯文本：这是一段示例播报纯文本
SSML：SSML使用请参考官方文档
fields.help_en: Content of the text to be spoken. Currently supports plain text and Alibaba Cloud Intelligent Speech Synthesis SSML markup language (for SSML usage guidelines, refer to Official Documentation (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462017.html)). The maximum text length is 1000 characters (excluding tags)
fields.help_zh: 播报文本的内容，目前支持纯文本和阿里云智能语音合成的SSML标记语言（SSML使用方案请参考官方文档 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462017.html)），最大文本长度1000字（不包含标签）
fields.name: speech_text

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to interrupt the previous speech during playback. By default, interruption is disabled
fields.help_zh: 播报时是否打断上一次播报内容，默认不打断
fields.name: interrupt

fields.help_en: VAML request type: this field can be left blank by default
fields.help_zh: VAML请求类型：默认可以不填
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: VAML protocol request. For details, see Official Documentation (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/444010.html)
fields.help_zh: VAML协议请求，具体参考官方文档 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/444010.html)
fields.name: vaml

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to send a callback notification when the digital human delivers this message. The default value is false. For more information, see Digital Human Callback Event Notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html)
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要在数字人进行播报该条消息的时候进行回调通知，默认值false，具体可参考：数字人回调事件通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html)
parameters.name: feedback

fields.help_en: Index of the current segment in the streaming broadcast
fields.name: index

fields.help_en: Indicates whether streaming broadcast is enabled
fields.name: is_stream

fields.help_en:
Segment position

start – First segment
mid   – Middle segment
end   – Last segment
fields.help_zh:
片段位置

start - 第一个开始片段
mid   - 中间的片段 
end   - 最后一个结束片段
fields.name: position

parameters.help_en: Stream extension object. Do not pass this object if streaming broadcast is not used. The user must split the text into segments (for example, by punctuation marks), and the digital human broadcasts the segments consecutively in the order they are submitted
parameters.help_zh: 流式播报扩展对象，不是流式播报，不传该对象。用户需要自己切分文本片段（比如说按照标点符号切分），数字人按照提交文本顺序连续的进行播报
parameters.name: stream_extension

Message.description_en: The message returned by the API call
